category_rule: Benchmarks are compared only within the declared category.

benchmarks.name: WebArena-Verified
benchmarks.environment: Self-hosted replicas of shopping, shopping admin, Reddit, GitLab, map and related WebArena services
benchmarks.online: No public Internet is required after images and assets are acquired
benchmarks.local_deployment: Yes, Docker or the official packaged environment
benchmarks.account_requirement: No purchased WebArena account; the environment supplies test identities and login support
benchmarks.input_and_trajectory: Natural-language task plus initial state. The upstream WebArena resources publish 179 human Playwright recordings; they cover only part of the 812 tasks
benchmarks.final_acceptance: Agent response, final service state and HAR network trace
benchmarks.scoring: Deterministic program evaluator; no LLM judge and no fuzzy substring match
benchmarks.difficulty: Official Hard subset contains 258 difficulty-prioritized tasks; the full set has no simple/medium labels
benchmarks.license: Apache-2.0 code; inspect dataset and environment component terms separately
benchmarks.cost: Local Docker storage, CPU and memory; trajectory replay itself has no model or judge fee
benchmarks.stability: Versioned, self-hosted and strongest for engine isolation. Environment initialization, evaluator versions and HAR completeness still need validation
benchmarks.known_issues: Only 179 tasks have public recordings; recordings and selectors can drift against newer images; four Wikipedia recordings in this project were non-native on amd64 and three tasks had confirmed evaluator defects

benchmarks.name: Online-Mind2Web
benchmarks.local_deployment: Harness and judge can run locally, but the websites are not self-hosted snapshots
benchmarks.account_requirement: Some sites or actions may require accounts; Browser Use's runner additionally requires its cloud API key
benchmarks.input_and_trajectory: Task, start website, screenshots, URL and agent trace. These are judge evidence, not a fixed action sequence
benchmarks.reference_trajectory: No public executable gold action trajectory; reference path length is metadata
benchmarks.final_acceptance: Whether the requested outcome was achieved, supported by the trajectory, screenshots and URLs
benchmarks.scoring: Official WebJudge is LLM-as-a-judge; current upstream also supports human submission review
benchmarks.difficulty: easy <=5, medium 6-10, hard >=11 steps in the human reference path; this is reference length, not site or agent execution difficulty
benchmarks.license: MIT repository; check dataset and visited-site terms
benchmarks.cost: Browser/model execution plus judge calls; live-site access and anti-bot handling add operational cost
benchmarks.stability: Strong public-ecosystem comparability, but tasks are periodically replaced when sites drift
benchmarks.known_issues: Live-page drift, CAPTCHA, anti-bot behavior and judge variance; a fixed successful agent trace cannot be assumed to remain replayable

benchmarks.name: BU Bench V1
benchmarks.task_count: 100: 20 each from custom, WebBench, Mind2Web 2, GAIA and BrowseComp
benchmarks.environment: Mixed live-web research and interaction tasks
benchmarks.local_deployment: Runner is public; the default setup uses Browser Use Cloud
benchmarks.account_requirement: BROWSER_USE_API_KEY and GOOGLE_API_KEY in the official runner
benchmarks.input_and_trajectory: Natural-language task; runner retains detailed execution traces
benchmarks.final_acceptance: Task answer or requested web outcome
benchmarks.difficulty: Hand-selected and confirmed achievable; no public simple/medium/hard split
benchmarks.license: Repository MIT; GAIA subset has no explicit license and is encrypted under its data policy
benchmarks.cost: Cloud browser, agent model and Google judge calls
benchmarks.stability: Useful for matching Browser Use's published practice, less controlled than a self-hosted benchmark
benchmarks.known_issues: Mixed provenance and research-heavy tasks confound browser engine, model, search strategy and judge behavior

benchmarks.name: WebVoyager
benchmarks.local_deployment: Runner is local; target sites remain external
benchmarks.account_requirement: Depends on site and model provider
benchmarks.input_and_trajectory: Task and live screenshots/DOM observations; released examples are agent runs, not gold actions
benchmarks.final_acceptance: Final answer plus the last screenshots
benchmarks.scoring: GPT-4V judge in the original implementation
benchmarks.license: Repository terms apply; visited-site terms are separate
benchmarks.cost: Agent model, browser operation and visual judge calls
benchmarks.stability: Historical comparison value is high; current reproducibility is low
benchmarks.known_issues: Date-sensitive tasks, page drift, site policy changes and visual-judge variance; later reproductions patch or remove tasks

benchmarks.name: Mind2Web
benchmarks.environment: Offline saved HTML snapshots and action annotations
benchmarks.account_requirement: No website account for offline evaluation
benchmarks.input_and_trajectory: Task, HTML snapshot, candidate elements and crowdsourced action sequence
benchmarks.reference_trajectory: Yes as offline element/action labels, but not as a runnable live-browser trajectory
benchmarks.final_acceptance: Element selection and operation prediction against annotated actions
benchmarks.scoring: Program metrics for element and action prediction
benchmarks.difficulty: Cross-task, cross-website and cross-domain generalization splits, not interaction-length tiers
benchmarks.license: Dataset/repository terms apply; includes a benchmark-data anti-contamination notice
benchmarks.cost: Local inference or model API only
benchmarks.stability: Offline and repeatable for prediction research
benchmarks.known_issues: Does not execute the website or validate final state, so it cannot directly compare Chromium with Moli

benchmarks.name: MiniWoB++
benchmarks.task_count: More than 100 synthetic web interaction environments
benchmarks.environment: Locally generated miniature web pages controlled through Selenium/Gymnasium
benchmarks.input_and_trajectory: Short instruction and synthetic page state; workflow demonstrations exist for some research setups but are not a universal fixed gold suite
benchmarks.reference_trajectory: Not a complete canonical gold trajectory set
benchmarks.difficulty: Per-environment task family; no common length-based tiers
benchmarks.known_issues: Good action primitive diagnostic, weak representation of modern real websites

benchmarks.name: OSWorld 2.0
benchmarks.environment: Linux desktop VMs/containers with browsers, Office-style apps, system tools, mocked sites and GitLab
benchmarks.online: Mixed; mocked sites can be self-hosted, while some optional services remain external
benchmarks.local_deployment: Yes on supported Docker/KVM infrastructure; AWS is also supported
benchmarks.account_requirement: Hugging Face login and gated-data acceptance; self-hosted GitLab credentials for relevant tasks
benchmarks.input_and_trajectory: Task, staged files and desktop state; model produces GUI/CLI trajectory
benchmarks.reference_trajectory: Published trajectories exist for analysis, but the benchmark is designed for autonomous execution rather than fixed replay
benchmarks.scoring: Execution-based evaluators plus partial-credit/model-evaluated components for some tasks
benchmarks.difficulty: Long-horizon workflows; median skilled-human duration is about 1.6 hours, not simple/medium/hard tiers
benchmarks.license: Repository and gated asset terms apply
benchmarks.cost: Large VM images, KVM/compute/storage, software and agent-model cost
benchmarks.stability: Versioned releases improve reproducibility, but all release-controlled components must match
benchmarks.known_issues: Far broader than browser use, so desktop planning and application support dilute browser-engine effects

benchmarks.name: Agents' Last Exam
benchmarks.task_count: 1,000+ corpus; around 150 public tasks across 55 subdomains
benchmarks.environment: Reproducible Windows and Linux professional desktop sandboxes using GUI and terminal tools
benchmarks.local_deployment: Framework is public; individual software and task sandboxes may have separate availability constraints
benchmarks.account_requirement: Depends on sandbox provider and professional software; leaderboard submission requires the project workflow
benchmarks.input_and_trajectory: Instruction, input data and initial sandbox state; normalized agent trajectory is recorded
benchmarks.reference_trajectory: No public fixed gold action path; hidden references grade deliverables
benchmarks.final_acceptance: Files, application state and other work products
benchmarks.scoring: Deterministic graders and LLM/VLM judges, depending on task
benchmarks.difficulty: Near-term, full-spectrum and last-exam tiers based on solvability and professional scope
benchmarks.cost: Sandbox, licensed software, compute and model calls
benchmarks.stability: Reproducible sandbox lifecycle, but it is a living benchmark
benchmarks.known_issues: Professional breadth and hidden graders make it unsuitable for isolating a browser engine

benchmarks.name: ScreenSpot-Pro
benchmarks.task_count: 1,581 screenshot-instruction pairs across 23 applications, five industries and three operating systems
benchmarks.environment: Static high-resolution screenshots of professional software
benchmarks.account_requirement: Dataset-host access may require an account; no application login is needed for scoring
benchmarks.input_and_trajectory: One screenshot and one instruction; model returns a point or box
benchmarks.reference_trajectory: Single annotated target only, not a trajectory
benchmarks.final_acceptance: Whether the predicted point falls inside the expert target box
benchmarks.difficulty: Professional high-resolution UI with very small, dense targets; no end-to-end step tiers
benchmarks.license: Dataset and leaderboard repository terms apply
benchmarks.stability: Static and stable for visual grounding
benchmarks.known_issues: Measures only where to click once; cannot validate navigation, state changes or browser compatibility

benchmarks.name: BrowseComp
benchmarks.environment: Open web plus a search/browsing interface chosen by the evaluated system
benchmarks.local_deployment: Dataset and evaluator can run locally; search corpus is live unless separately frozen
benchmarks.account_requirement: Depends on chosen search and model providers
benchmarks.input_and_trajectory: Question; systems may emit search and browsing traces, but no action path is prescribed
benchmarks.scoring: Reference answer with the official evaluation procedure
benchmarks.difficulty: Questions were filtered to resist frontier models and shallow searches; difficulty is information retrieval, not GUI operation
benchmarks.license: OpenAI simple-evals dataset terms and canary/anti-contamination requirements apply
benchmarks.cost: Search, browsing and model calls can be high because tasks require persistent research
benchmarks.stability: Answers were designed to be stable, while web evidence availability can still change
benchmarks.known_issues: A system may solve it through APIs or search tools without operating a browser UI

benchmarks.name: Mind2Web 2
benchmarks.environment: Live web research with citation-backed synthesis
benchmarks.local_deployment: Evaluation scripts are public; web and model access remain external
benchmarks.account_requirement: Depends on search/model provider; leaderboard submission has its own process
benchmarks.input_and_trajectory: Complex research request, answer and cited webpages; no fixed GUI action sequence
benchmarks.final_acceptance: Correctness and source attribution of the synthesized answer
benchmarks.difficulty: Long-horizon, current-information synthesis; no Online-Mind2Web path-length tiers
benchmarks.cost: Search, browser/model execution and judge-agent calls
benchmarks.stability: Evaluation scripts are public, but answers and sources can be time-varying
benchmarks.known_issues: Measures research and synthesis more than browser UI control; must not be merged with Online-Mind2Web
